title: run_esm_admin_jobs
description: ESM admin (maintenance) jobs in the documented order with progress. jobs: default (recommended), catalog, pricing, promotions, repair, or job keys. mode=preview lists the jobs (automatic and manual steps); after the person approves, mode=commit with previewToken and same inputs starts them in the background and returns a jobId and a Progress tracker card. mode=status (jobId) shows progress and plain-language errors. A failed run resumes from the failed step: mode=preview with jobId, approval, then mode=commit with jobId. Only one run at a time.

mode.description: preview (default), commit after approval, or status.

jobs.description: default, catalog, pricing, promotions, repair or job keys.

jobId.description: Codey job id for status or resume.

previewToken.description: Token from the preview, for commit.

confirmProduction.description: true only if the person confirmed running jobs in production.

message.description: Plain-language result to tell the person.

previewToken.description: Returned by a preview; pass it back with mode=commit and the same inputs only after the person approved.

fix.description: How to resolve a problem when success is false.
